name: Moonlight View Cottage — Jibhi
location: Jibhi hills above market (waterfall-road side); ~1.2–1.5 km from Jibhi market; ~10–15 min walk to market cafe cluster (OpenBook/Bleeblu belt)
cleanliness: 5.0/5; reviews repeat “neat wooden interiors, clean bedding/bath”
view: Cedar-wood cottage on hill; mountain + valley views from room + sit-out deck; ask upper sun-facing side
amenities: Kitchen, WiFi + workspace, parking assistance (host helps with 600 m uphill luggage), bonfire on request
why: Proven 88-review hill quiet above market noise; wooden Ruskin-Bond aesthetic built by host family. The 600 m climb filters crowds — ideal slow-morning pine-view couple base within walking reach of cafes.

name: Bastiat Stays – Whispering Pines Cabin — Tandi
type: Airbnb Treehouse / Homestay (book Cabin, not Jacuzzi Treehouse, to hold budget)
location: Tandi village above Jibhi (Sajwar/Tandi belt); ~7–8 km drive from Jibhi market; nearest cafe cluster Jibhi market (~20 min drive)
cleanliness: 4.8–4.9; “cozy, well-kept pine interiors”; rustic forest property, not hotel-sterile
view: 360° Greater Himalaya aspect; pine forest all sides; valley-view deck + lawn access
amenities: WiFi + workspace, home-cooked Himachali food (~₹300 veg), bonfire on request, Airtel/Jio good, no loud music after 8 pm
why: Quintessential quiet/hippie Tandi — wheat fields, orchards, flying squirrels, enforced quiet hours. One of India's most-reviewed Jibhi hosts; best forest-immersion + stargazing pick on the list.

name: Latoda – The Tree House — Ghiyagi/Jibhi forest
location: Lushal forest between Ghiyagi and Jibhi; ~5–6 km from Jibhi market; ~10 min drive to Ghiyagi/Jibhi cafes
cleanliness: Tagged for cleanliness; “crisp, clean pine-wood interiors”
view: Spacious balcony over forest; large windows; rare 6-peak Himalayan view claim; oak trees around; living-tree-through-room in places
amenities: Homemade Himachali meals by host, WiFi, parking, forest trail + wooden pathway access
why: Secluded forest hideaway between Jibhi and Shoja — silent nights, peak views by day, easy scooty access both ways. Strong 200-review proof at this price.

name: Wayward Inn Entire Place — Ghiyagi
location: Ghiyagi (between Jibhi and Shoja); ~4 km from Jibhi market; ~3 km from Shoja cafes (Jaani's/Rustic)
cleanliness: 4.7+; “charming stone+wood, well-kept”; large review base = reliable
view: Stone-wood cottage in greenery; private balcony/patio; valley + orchard views
amenities: Kitchen, WiFi, garden, parking, pet-friendly belt
why: Ghiyagi is the quiet sweet spot — neither Jibhi crowd nor Shoja wind. Entire-place privacy for a couple, balcony breakfasts, forest walks from the door, and both market clusters within short scooty reach.

name: Tandi Mountain Cottage with Jibhi Valley View — Tandi
location: Tandi (Sajwar side); ~6–7 km from Jibhi market; ~20 min drive to Jibhi cafes
cleanliness: Positive for condition/clean; rustic blue-window hut, well-kept
view: Elevated hut among tall trees; Jibhi Valley panorama; private balcony/deck
amenities: Kitchenette, WiFi, parking, heater on request
why: Colder, quieter Tandi air with valley panorama from bed and zero market hum. Narrow-road filter keeps it calm; good base for Chehni + Jalori loops on a scooty day.

name: Mudhouse Peaks N Valley Stays — Chhet (Chehni road)
location: Chhet village, Chehni road; ~3–4 km from Jibhi market; minutes from market/waterfall/Chehni trek; ~10 min to cafes
rating: 5.0 (14 reviews) — Airbnb (Guest Favourite Top 10%, Superhost, Cleanliness 5.0, Location 5.0)
cleanliness: 5.0; “spotless mud finish, cozy bedding”
view: Cliff-perched; sweeping valley views; private deck + private hot-tub option; bonfire/BBQ under stars
amenities: Self check-in, kitchen, organic farm access, bonfire, parking
why: Most aesthetic “off-grid but close” pick — mud architecture, cliff privacy, hot-tub + stars, Chehni Kothi hike base. Thin review count (14) flagged; consider 2N splurge + 2N budget split. NOTE: all-in exceeds ₹2500 cap by ~₹330 — exceptional-exception candidate.

name: The Lost Escape Riverside Cottage — Jibhi riverside orchard
location: Riverside orchard offbeat downhill trail; ~1.5–2 km from Jibhi market (700 m jungle trail from road, porter help); ~15 min walk to cafes
cleanliness: High for riverside; “wooden interiors, clean bath, fresh meals”
view: River + mountain view balcony; orchard + pine/cedar forest; birdsong all day
amenities: In-house cafe dining, outdoor dining, 5G WiFi, garden sit-out
why: Trail access is a natural crowd filter — river steps away, forest immersion, no road honk. True quiet (water + trout + fireflies). Thin count (19) flagged but 5.0 Superhost; couple-perfect.

name: Om Homestay Cottage — Jibhi outskirts
location: Jibhi outskirts set back from road; ~0.8–1.2 km from market — walkable but peaceful; ~5–10 min walk to cafes
cleanliness: Consistently “calm, clean, tidy rooms, bonfire evenings”
view: Peaceful mountain views; cottage balcony/terrace; trek-trail access
amenities: Bonfire, parking, home food, WiFi
why: Best “close-but-quiet” compromise — cafes by day, silence at night. 5.0 across 58 reviews is a safe couple bet at a budget-friendly price.

name: Serenity Wooden Cottage — Jibhi outskirts
location: Jibhi outskirts; ~1–2 km from market; ~10 min walk/scooty to cafe cluster
cleanliness: “Home away from home, peaceful + comforts of home”; cleanliness praised
view: Wooden duplex among greenery; valley/mountain balcony
amenities: Kitchen, WiFi, power backup, parking
why: 100-review proof of quiet comfort; wood aesthetic, morning sun, calm nights. Strong 4–5N slow-stay pick rather than hopping.

name: Hillhouse Sisters A-Frame Farm Stay — Jibhi farm belt
location: Jibhi outskirts farm belt; ~2–3 km from market; ~10 min scooty to cafes
rating: 4.95 (20 reviews) — Airbnb (Guest Favourite, Cleanliness 5.0, Value 5.0, Superhost)
cleanliness: 5.0; “spotless A-frame, fresh farm air”
view: Valley views; large glass windows; farm + greenery surround; deck for tea/stars
amenities: WiFi 39 Mbps + workspace, firepit, pets allowed, parking
why: Hippie-aesthetic A-frame with farm life, birdsong mornings, starry nights. Modern comfort + rustic charm, workation-friendly. Thin count (20) flagged but 5.0 clean/value.

name: Silence of Pines / Seri Homestay — Seri, Waterfall Road
location: Seri village, Jibhi Waterfall Road; 200 m from Jibhi Waterfall; ~2 km from market; ~15 min walk to cafes
rating: ~4.5 (Google, ~80 reviews) + Homestays-of-India listing; long-stay reviews praise hosts
cleanliness: “Comfortable, home-cooked, clean attached baths”; 5 rooms only, personal care
view: Pine-forest cottages; valley-view balcony; river walk nearby
amenities: Parking, WiFi, hot water, bonfire, pet-friendly, library
why: Walk-to-waterfall forest quiet with a host couple that goes the extra mile. Two small cottages = intimate, not hotel corridor. Ideal birding/reading/stargazing couple stay.

name: Moustache Shoja Deluxe Double with Balcony — Shoja
location: Shoja, NH-305; ~7–8 km from Jibhi market (25 min drive); 3.4 km from Jalori Pass; Shoja cafes walkable
cleanliness: Chain housekeeping; private bath + shower, linen included — more consistent than solo homestays
view: Deluxe = private balcony mountain views; Budget double = shared balcony (book Deluxe)
amenities: Garden, shared lounge, bonfire/movie nights, restaurant, parking, WiFi, heating, electric kettle
why: Hippie-social by day, private-room quiet by night — cedar + valley backdrop, Jalori sunrise easy. Best toggle for community + couple retreat, with chain-level cleanliness reliability.

name: Zostel Shoja Private Room — Shoja
location: Shoja, NH-305; ~7 km from Jibhi market; ~3 km from waterfall by road; Shoja cafes walkable
rating: Chain; backpacker ratings high (Shoja unit ~8.7 Booking/hostelworld); dorms ~₹500–700
cleanliness: Chain SOP; housekeeping, 24-hr security, adults-only calm zones
view: Terrace + garden furniture; mountain-view rooms; sitting area in select privates — request valley-facing private
amenities: Restaurant, outdoor bar, garden, bonfire, WiFi, parking
why: Shoja pine + Jalori views with social-cafe energy by day and private retreat by night. Reliable Oct backup if homestays fill; chain consistency for a young couple.

name: Tirthan Crest Homestay — Sidhwan, Banjar edge
location: Sidhwan, Banjar edge (Tirthan side); ~9–10 km from Jibhi market; 15-min walk to Banjar centre; Tirthan River 4.4 km
rating: B&B listing; 9 rooms; breakfast-included reviews (~8.6 aggregator)
cleanliness: B&B standards; cupboard rooms, 24-hr security
view: Balcony rooms + garden views; ask upper balcony room
amenities: Breakfast included, garden, parking, WiFi, security
why: Banjar-edge calm with riverside + GHNP access without Jibhi weekend crowd. Cheapest B&B balcony base — good for a Jibhi+Tirthan split or budget buffer.

name: Riverside Serenity Cottage — Gushaini, Tirthan Valley
location: Gushaini, Tirthan Valley; ~19–20 km from Jibhi market (50 min drive) — separate valley base; Gushaini cafes walkable
cleanliness: “Simple, comfortable, nature-focused”; 6 cleanliness mentions; river + hospitality praised
view: Private balcony river + mountain views; river steps away; room-window river view; garden sit-out
amenities: Fast WiFi 126 Mbps, free parking, meals on request; Chhoie Waterfall 1.5 km hike
why: Wake to river sound + mountain air, not road. Quiet riverside neighbourhood with waterfall hike from the door. Best Tirthan analogue to the Jibhi balcony brief — ideal 2N Jibhi + 2N Tirthan split.

name: Himalayan Cedar Nest — Sainj (extension anchor)
location: Sainj valley (near Jibhi circuit); ~30–35 km from Jibhi market — extension/day-trip base, not daily commute; Sainj cafes local
cleanliness: 44-review consistency = rare reliable housekeeping for Sainj at this price
view: Cottage format; balcony + river/garden views (Sainj riverside belt); forest quiet
amenities: Garden, kitchen option, parking, WiFi, bonfire on request
why: Highest-proof Sainj budget pick (44 reviews at 9.5). Cottage privacy + cedar forest + river sound. Extension anchor: justifies +1N (Oct 8–9) via Shangarh meadows loop, escaping Jibhi weekend surge.

name: Mountain Nest Stay — Hirab, Sajwar Road
location: Village Hirab, Hirab–Sajwar Road, Shoja/Jibhi; ~3–4 km above market in untouched belt; ~10 min drive to cafes
cleanliness: Premium mattresses/bedding, 24/7 hot water noted; direct-booking housekeeping
view: Private balcony with panoramic valley views; upper rooms face sunrise ridge
amenities: Room heaters (winter), electric kettle + tea, WiFi, ample storage, bonfire, parking
why: Handcrafted-cottage romantic escape above the clouds with direct valley views and no market noise. At-cap premium pick for couples wanting boutique comfort + phones-lose-signal quiet. NOTE: all-in ~₹190 over cap — flagged edge.

name: Tirthan Riverview Homestay — Ropajani, Gushaini
location: Village Ropajani, Tirthan Valley (GHNP buffer gateway); ~1 hr drive from Aut; ~20 km from Jibhi; riverside trail cafes local
rating: Direct listing; buffer-zone homestay with repeat-guest base (aggregator ~8.8)
cleanliness: Wood-stone-mud house; 4 well-furnished doubles, attached baths, hot water; linen noted
view: All bedrooms open to spacious shared + room balconies with Tirthan River + pine forest view
amenities: Internet, laundry, parking, taxi/trek/camp/fishing-gear hire, MAP meals available
why: GHNP-buffer solitude — 10-family village, river at the door, traditional-meets-modern house. Perfect solitude-seeker couple base with angling/trek support; cheapest river-view balcony on the list.

name: Jaabal Riverside Homestay — Jawal, Badiropa, Tirthan Valley
location: Village Jawal, Badiropa, Tirthan Valley; ~20 km from Jibhi via Banjar; riverside dining/fire area
rating: Direct listing; guest notes “clean, spacious, river-view” (aggregator ~8.7)
cleanliness: Super Deluxe noted clean/spacious; soft bedding; garden + dining upkeep
view: Super Deluxe + Duplex rooms = balcony + Tirthan River view; ground Deluxe = garden sit-out (book upper balcony room)
amenities: Dining area, fire area, garden, parking; min 2-day booking in peak
why: Riverside retreat where the river is audible from bed; balcony + garden + fire area for couple evenings. Must book Super Deluxe/Duplex for the balcony — then it beats town stays on quiet + view per rupee.

name: Mizuki Retreat + Cafe — Pekhri road above Gushaini
location: Pekhri road above Gushaini, Tirthan Valley; ~21 km from Jibhi; in-house cafe; GHNP next door
cleanliness: Simple, warm rooms; blankets + toiletries noted; cafe kitchen standards
view: Every room mountain-facing; private balcony over valley; sun terrace + outdoor fireplace
amenities: In-house cafe (Himachali plates, trout when available, coffee), video-call-grade WiFi, shared lounge, bonfire, parking
why: Five-room quiet with the cafe one floor away — mountain views from every room, trout below, national park next door. Best “stay where you eat” Tirthan pick for cafe-focused couples.

name: The Forest Lens Treehouse (HomeTales) — Jibhi forest
location: Jibhi forest belt; 5-min trek from parking (host picks luggage); ~2–3 km from market; ~10 min to cafes
rating: Superhost 6 yrs (Airbnb; panoramic-view tags; exact count varies by season — verify live)
cleanliness: Professional hospitality team; power backup + food-service upkeep noted
view: Panoramic mountain + valley deck; scenic forest sit-out; bonfire area
amenities: WiFi, power backup, food service, bonfire area, parking facility (meals/heaters/bonfire extra)
why: Purpose-built forest escape run by ex-hospitality professionals — panoramic views, 5-min trek crowd filter, reliable service layer rare in treehouses. NOTE: all-in ~₹70 over cap — flagged edge; verify exact fee at booking.

name: Rocky’s Retreat A-Frame Orchard — Jibhi (6 km out)
location: Apple-orchard belt ~6 km from Jibhi market (Jalori 18 km / waterfall 6 km / Chhoie 4 km); 5-min walk from road; night service till 10 pm, no loud music
rating: Superhost (Airbnb; A-frame orchard listing; verify live count)
cleanliness: Pinewood upkeep noted; in-house food service; all-weather AC
view: Spacious balcony; amazing mountain view; pinewood architecture; orchard + lawn access
amenities: WiFi, bonfire area, in-house food, parking; village rules enforced (quiet)
why: Dreamy orchard A-frame — rustic pinewood outside, modern comfort inside, enforced quiet. 6 km buffer from market + Jalori/Chhoie equidistance makes it a strong scooty-day hub for couples.
